common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished high-end Korean science-fiction game inventory equipment asset, part of a coherent four-piece MYTHIC SF equipment set. Art direction: the commanding hard-surface industrial armor language of Halo, elevated to an ancient hyper-advanced civilization relic. Original design, no existing franchise insignia or logos. Strong engineered armor geometry, broad beveled interlocking plates, deep graphite structural skeleton, pearlescent cold titanium-silver ceramic main plates, a few dark desaturated blue inset planes, very restrained pale champagne metal at precision joints (at most 5% of surface). Bright ice-blue and brilliant white energy emitters recessed into the structure with subtle controlled bloom. The prestige comes from pristine materials, a powerful sculptural silhouette, extreme engineering refinement, and impossibly advanced energy mechanisms. Tactile brushed metal, clean crisp panel separation, narrow machining grooves, robust physically coherent attachments. Premium polished 2D game item illustration with dimensional material lighting, not cartoon, not a gritty real-world military photograph, not cheap plastic. No medieval filigree, no engraved floral patterns, no jewels, no ruby/gem inlays, no angel wings, no cloth cape, no magic runes or sigils, no organic spikes, no crowns, no excessive micro-greebles, no text, no labels, no UI, no frame, no watermark. Isolated object on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background; the entire silhouette must fit inside the square with 10% clean transparent margin. Soft cool studio lighting with a white rim and controlled ice-blue internal light. Orthographic-like product composition with slight three-quarter depth. Centered, elegant readability at inventory icon size.
